newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Fijian woman and two sons in Sydney death nystery.
newsitem.headline: Fijian woman and two sons in Sydney death nystery.

text.p: Australian police are investigating the deaths of a Fijian woman and her two young sons, found in a backyard swimming pool in Sydney on Sunday.
Neighbours told reporters the woman, a Fiji Indian, had recently been refused Australian residency after coming to the country to start a new life.
They also said her husband had recently left her for another woman.
A police spokesman said the deaths of the woman, 30, and her sons, 10 and two, were being treated as suspicious.

They were found about noon in the pool of the western Sydney house where they were living with relatives. The woman and her younger son were dead, but the 10-year-old was still alive, police said. However, he died in hospital soon after.
